description: Split any image into an even grid of tiles — pick rows and columns, preview every piece, and download the tiles individually as PNG files.

faqs.a: Each tile is saved as a PNG at the exact pixel size of its slice, so no quality is lost in the split.
faqs.q: What format and quality are the tiles?

faqs.a: Yes — rows and columns can be set from 1 to 10 independently, so grids like 3×2 or 1×4 work fine.
faqs.q: Can I use different numbers of rows and columns?

faqs.a: No. The image is loaded, sliced and saved entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

howto: Choose how many rows and columns to split it into.
Click “Split” to preview every tile in the grid.
Download any tile individually, or all tiles at once.
title: Image Splitter
